#region Usings
using Microsoft.Data.SqlClient;
using SFTest.Entity.TestDb.Coverage;
using SFTest.Entity.Utils.TestDb.Coverage;
using SFTest.Query;
using SFTest.Repository.Common;
using SFTest.Repository.Container;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
#endregion

/// <summary>
/// Runs paged reads through the code generated for the Coverage model against a real SQL Server (GeneratedPagingTests
/// compiles and runs it; it is not part of the test project). The generated readers are sequential
/// (CommandBehavior.SequentialAccess), so reading a column out of order fails only here, on a real database.
/// Writes "PASS name" per case; exits with 1 and the reason on the first failure.
/// </summary>
internal static class Program
{
    private const string _country = "ZZ";
    private const int _regionCount = 25;
    private const int _storesPerRegion = 2;

    private static int Main()
    {
        //in the environment, not on the command line, so a password does not show in the process list
        var connectionString = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SF_PAGING_CONNECTION");
        Database.RegisterModelConnectionString(RepoLookup.ModelId.TestDb, connectionString);
        try
        {
            DeleteTestRows(connectionString);
            InsertTestRows(connectionString);
            RunAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
            Console.WriteLine("ALL PASSED");
            return 0;
        }
        catch(Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("FAIL " + ex);
            return 1;
        }
        finally
        {
            DeleteTestRows(connectionString);
        }
    }

    private static async Task RunAsync()
    {
        var container = new RepositoryContainer();
        var regions = container.TestDb.Coverage.Region;
        var stores = container.TestDb.Coverage.Store;

        //page 2 of 3: R11 to R20, with the total
        var withTotal = RegionPage(2, true);
        CheckRegions("page with the total", regions.ToList(withTotal), 11);
        CheckTotal("page with the total", withTotal.RecordCount, withTotal.PageCount, _regionCount, 3);

        var withTotalAsync = RegionPage(2, true);
        CheckRegions("page with the total, async", await regions.ToListAsync(withTotalAsync), 11);
        CheckTotal("page with the total, async", withTotalAsync.RecordCount, withTotalAsync.PageCount, _regionCount, 3);

        //the last page has 5 rows
        var lastPage = RegionPage(3, true);
        CheckRegions("last page", regions.ToList(lastPage), 21);

        var withoutTotal = RegionPage(1, false);
        CheckRegions("page without the total", regions.ToList(withoutTotal), 1);

        //a to-many navigation property on a paged query
        var withStores = RegionPage(2, true).BeginNavProps().Append(RegionNavProperty.Stores).EndNavProps();
        var regionsWithStores = regions.ToList(withStores);
        CheckRegions("page with a to-many navigation property", regionsWithStores, 11);
        foreach(var region in regionsWithStores)
        {
            if(region.Stores == null || region.Stores.Count != _storesPerRegion)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"page with a to-many navigation property: {region.RegionCode} has {region.Stores?.Count ?? 0} stores, expected {_storesPerRegion}");
        }

        Console.WriteLine("PASS page with a to-many navigation property, its rows");
        //the navigation property's result set must not change the page's total
        CheckTotal("page with a to-many navigation property", withStores.RecordCount, withStores.PageCount, _regionCount, 3);

        //navigation properties given with a collection initializer (NavProps<T> is a collection)
        var oneRegion = await regions.ByPKAsync(_country, RegionCode(1), new NavProps<RegionProperty> { RegionNavProperty.Stores });
        if(oneRegion == null || oneRegion.Stores == null || oneRegion.Stores.Count != _storesPerRegion)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"navigation properties from a collection initializer: {oneRegion?.Stores?.Count ?? 0} stores, expected {_storesPerRegion}");

        Console.WriteLine("PASS navigation properties from a collection initializer");

        //a to-one navigation property on a paged query, sync and async
        var storePage = StorePage();
        CheckStores("page with a to-one navigation property", stores.ToList(storePage));
        CheckTotal("page with a to-one navigation property", storePage.RecordCount, storePage.PageCount, _regionCount * _storesPerRegion, 5);

        var storePageAsync = StorePage();
        CheckStores("page with a to-one navigation property, async", await stores.ToListAsync(storePageAsync));

        //an update from changes: GetChanges and CreateChange through Set(change), the same Set clause as Set(prop, value)
        var code = RegionCode(1);
        var original = await regions.ByPKAsync(_country, code);
        var changed = new Region { CountryCode = original.CountryCode, RegionCode = original.RegionCode, Name = "Changed " + code };
        var changes = RegionUtils.GetChanges(original, changed);
        await regions.UpdateAsync(RegionUpdate(code).BeginUpdateValues().Set(changes[0]).EndUpdateValues());
        CheckName("update from GetChanges", (await regions.ByPKAsync(_country, code)).Name, "Changed " + code);

        await regions.UpdateAsync(RegionUpdate(code).BeginUpdateValues().Set(RegionProperty.CreateChange((int)RegionProp.Name, "Named " + code)).EndUpdateValues());
        CheckName("update from CreateChange", (await regions.ByPKAsync(_country, code)).Name, "Named " + code);
    }

    private static Query<RegionProperty> RegionUpdate(string code)
    {
        return new Query<RegionProperty>()
            .BeginPredicate().Where(RegionProperty.CountryCode).Equals(_country).Where(RegionProperty.RegionCode).Equals(code).EndPredicate();
    }

    private static void CheckName(string name, string actual, string expected)
    {
        if(!string.Equals(actual, expected, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{name}: the name is {actual}, expected {expected}");

        Console.WriteLine("PASS " + name);
    }

    private static Query<RegionProperty> RegionPage(int pageNumber, bool returnTotal)
    {
        return new Query<RegionProperty>()
            .BeginPredicate().Where(RegionProperty.CountryCode).Equals(_country).EndPredicate()
            .BeginSorting().OrderBy(RegionProperty.RegionCode).EndSorting()
            .BeginPagination().PageSize(10).PageNumber(pageNumber).ReturnTotalCount(returnTotal).EndPagination();
    }

    private static Query<StoreProperty> StorePage()
    {
        return new Query<StoreProperty>()
            .BeginPredicate().Where(StoreProperty.CountryCode).Equals(_country).EndPredicate()
            .BeginSorting().OrderBy(StoreProperty.Name).EndSorting()
            .BeginPagination().PageSize(10).PageNumber(1).ReturnTotalCount(true).EndPagination()
            .BeginNavProps().Append(StoreNavProperty.Region).EndNavProps();
    }

    private static void CheckRegions(string name, List<Region> rows, int first)
    {
        var expected = Math.Min(10, _regionCount - first + 1);
        if(rows == null || rows.Count != expected)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{name}: {rows?.Count ?? 0} rows, expected {expected}");

        for(var i = 0; i < rows.Count; i++)
        {
            var code = RegionCode(first + i);
            if(!string.Equals(rows[i].RegionCode, code, StringComparison.Ordinal) || !string.Equals(rows[i].Name, "Paging " + code, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"{name}: row {i} is {rows[i].RegionCode} / {rows[i].Name}, expected {code}");
        }

        Console.WriteLine("PASS " + name);
    }

    private static void CheckStores(string name, List<Store> rows)
    {
        if(rows == null || rows.Count != 10)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{name}: {rows?.Count ?? 0} rows, expected 10");

        foreach(var store in rows)
        {
            if(store.Region == null || !string.Equals(store.Region.RegionCode, store.RegionCode, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"{name}: store {store.Name} has no region or the wrong one");
        }

        Console.WriteLine("PASS " + name);
    }

    private static void CheckTotal(string name, double recordCount, int pageCount, int expectedRecords, int expectedPages)
    {
        if(recordCount != expectedRecords || pageCount != expectedPages)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{name}: total {recordCount} in {pageCount} pages, expected {expectedRecords} in {expectedPages}");

        Console.WriteLine("PASS " + name + ", the total");
    }

    private static string RegionCode(int number)
    {
        return "R" + number.ToString("00", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }

    private static void InsertTestRows(string connectionString)
    {
        var sql = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        for(var i = 1; i <= _regionCount; i++)
        {
            var code = RegionCode(i);
            sql.Append($"INSERT INTO Coverage.Region (CountryCode, RegionCode, Name) VALUES ('{_country}', '{code}', N'Paging {code}');");
            for(var s = 1; s <= _storesPerRegion; s++)
                sql.Append($"INSERT INTO Coverage.Store (CountryCode, RegionCode, Name) VALUES ('{_country}', '{code}', N'Paging {code} store {s}');");
        }

        Execute(connectionString, sql.ToString());
    }

    private static void DeleteTestRows(string connectionString)
    {
        Execute(connectionString, $"DELETE FROM Coverage.Store WHERE CountryCode = '{_country}'; DELETE FROM Coverage.Region WHERE CountryCode = '{_country}';");
    }

    private static void Execute(string connectionString, string sql)
    {
        using(var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
        {
            connection.Open();
            using(var command = new SqlCommand(sql, connection))
                command.ExecuteNonQuery();
        }
    }
}
